source_segments.text: Lyudmila Bragina Lyudmila Ivanovna Bragina (, born 24 July 1943) is a retired Russian middle distance runner.
She competed for the Soviet Union in the 1500 m at the 1972 and 1976 Olympics; she won the event in 1972 and finished fifth in 1976.

In July 1972 she set a new 1500 m world record of 4:06.9, at the Soviet championships, and then progressively improved it in round 1 (4:06.47), the semi-finals (4:05.07}, and the final (4:01.38), of the 1972 Olympics.
The same year she was awarded the Order of the Red Banner of Labour.
